high_signal_works.summary_zh: 先用零样本 VLM 收集次优交互训练动作条件视频世界模型，再在想象 rollout 中强化微调高层 planner。
high_signal_works.title: DreamPlan: Efficient Reinforcement Fine-Tuning of Vision-Language Planners via Video World Models

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 把 inverse dynamics model 反用作奖励模型，以速度、加速度、jerk 和本体约束对视频世界模型做可执行性对齐。
high_signal_works.title: EVA: Aligning Video World Models with Executable Robot Actions via Inverse Dynamics Rewards

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 以架子鼓把手内控制、反复接触和长时序双手协调合并为统一测试床，并用规划加 residual RL 实现 sim-to-real。
high_signal_works.title: DexDrummer: In-Hand, Contact-Rich, and Long-Horizon Dexterous Robot Drumming

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 将 50K 轨迹、八种灵巧手、FAAS 统一动作空间、3D VLA 与便携采集装置组成 universal dexterous foundation suite。
high_signal_works.title: UniDex: A Robot Foundation Suite for Universal Dexterous Hand Control from Egocentric Human Videos

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 用 20 个实体任务、10,812 条专家轨迹和成对 real-to-sim 场景，为 VLA/WAM 提供可诊断的统一真实机器人评测。
high_signal_works.title: ManipArena: Comprehensive Real-world Evaluation of Reasoning-Oriented Generalist Robot Manipulation
A Novel Reconfigurable Dexterous Hand Based on Triple-Symmetric Bricard Parallel Mechanism
